'''Aurek Flight''' was a flight group within the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]]. They, alongside the fighter wing itself, were presented during a special ceremony hosted by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]] shortly after the events of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
